label: data:domain
rationale: FSL FEAT design file (fMRI analysis configuration in Tcl `set fmri(...)` syntax, read by FSL's FEAT GUI): 80.6 % of files and 66.8 % of repositories; a further 11.9 % / 14.0 % are git-annex pointers to annexed designs. 1641/1662 judged files are not a programming language. `data:domain` (domain-specific format of one application) fits better than `data:config` (generic INI/TOML-style syntaxes). This contradicts the example `.fsf → pl/new:fsl` in docs/extension_labels.md: FEAT designs parametrise a pipeline and do not compute. Polysemy tail: XML fractal saves, GLSL shaders, IDE settings.
